faq_heading: Heritage Mountain houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Heritage Mountain. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Heritage Mountain, Port Moody: 10 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 40%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Heritage Mountain fell from 11 in June to 10 in September (−9.1%), and 10 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.4% of Port Moody’s 135 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Heritage Mountain?
Heritage Mountain also had 5 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in September, against 10 houses listed. The Heritage Mountain condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

19 houses sold in Heritage Mountain with a median price of $1,750,000 (the middle half sold between $1,676,500 and $2,070,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $460 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median lot of 6,543 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Heritage Mountain. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Heritage Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Heritage Mountain had a sales ratio of 40%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Heritage Mountain from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Heritage Mountain over those 4 months, out of 51 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Heritage Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Heritage Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,750,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 14 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
